name: Mehmet Oz
current_role: Administrator of the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (since April 2025)
summary: Mehmet Oz, the heart surgeon and former TV host who lost Pennsylvania’s 2022 Senate race as Trump’s endorsed Republican, was confirmed 53–45 on April 3, 2025, to run Medicare and Medicaid, among the officials Kennedy installed across HHS.
